summary.text: Earth path immortal materials are immortal materials of earth path, produced by earth qi and spent to raise earth path dao marks.

claims.text: If earth qi in an immortal aperture grows too dense, it can form earth qi sandstorms that harm the surroundings, yet a large amount of earth path immortal materials are produced during those sandstorms. Fang Yuan does not lack earth path immortal materials, so he chooses to divert earth qi into tunnels rather than let sandstorms form.

Virtue Paradise does not lack rank eight earth path immortal materials, and Lu Wei Yin can use extreme serene mind tea to accumulate earth path dao marks beyond common sense. One bowl of that tea uses a large number of rank eight earth path immortal materials to give only several hundred earth path dao marks.

Fang Yuan’s time path clone stuffs earth path immortal materials into Shi Zong’s immortal aperture before a tribulation, including worry soil, green pond rotten soil, diamond soil, great lake soil, concealing heaven dust, grand soil, region sand, impermanence rock, smoky warm jade, thousand year frost jade essence, dark inkstone, marrow sucking stone, regret water rock, round kun stone, hibiscus stalactite, stone heart liquid, eight-parts jade, and more. That large number of earth path immortal materials intensifies the coming grand tribulation.
